title: Zephyrine and the Ghost
author: August Whitlock
blurb: Beatrix Amberdale, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
